sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Whole CI job
sections.what: Runs on pull requests and on pushes to main, master and overhaul. It starts Postgres, installs packages, generates the database client, installs the browser for tests, applies migrations, runs the verification script and uploads evidence even if the run fails.
sections.why: Likely reason: a single gate that proves a change works before it is merged.
sections.watch_out: The test secret is fixed in this file. It is for CI only, but it must never be reused as a real secret.

summary: Automatic check that runs on pull requests and on pushes to the main branches: it starts a database, installs packages, runs the verification script and uploads evidence.
purpose: Catch broken changes before they reach the main branches.
why: Likely reason: one automatic gate on every change. The reason for the branch list is not stated in the code.
how: 1) Start a Postgres service. 2) Check out the code and install Node 22 and the packages. 3) Generate the database client. 4) Install the browser if needed. 5) Run migrations if the script exists. 6) Run the verification script in CI mode. 7) Upload the evidence folders and reports, even if the run failed.
inputs: The repository code, the workflow settings, and the fixed test database and secret.
outputs: A pass or fail status, and an artifact bundle kept for 14 days.
risks: A fixed test secret and database password are stored in the file. The contents of the verification script are not shown, so what it checks is unknown.
debug: If the job fails at migrations, check the database health check. If the browser install fails, check the Playwright version. Download the evidence artifact to read the reports.
